title: Durations with units
prompt:
`parse_duration` in src/lib.rs only understands plain seconds ("90"). Config files now use units: make it accept
combinations of `h`, `m`, `s` and `ms` such as "1h30m", "45s", "250ms" or "2h5s" (plain numbers stay seconds). Empty
input, unknown units, a unit without a number and repeated units must return `Err(ParseError)`.
